text: A UK DJ found a Transmat record.
A phone number was on the sleeve.
slides.sub: Neil Rushton. Six months later, everything changed.

text: 'Techno — The New Dance Sound of Detroit.'
The title was almost 'New House Sound.'
One song name changed the word.
slides.sub: Juan Atkins had a track called 'Techno Music.'
Distance did not matter. The emotion was the same.
